name: barbell frog stance deadlift
description: A deadlift with a wide, toes-out stance. It shortens the range and loads the glutes and inner thighs.
instructions: Stand with feet wide, toes turned out, and a bar over mid-foot.
Hinge and bend your knees to grip the bar.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Drive through your feet to stand tall.
